verdict.rationale: Honeycomb Boards let SRE teams save, organize, and share analysis components with pre-built templates for common use cases, and queries can include grouping, visualizations, and derived columns. However, evidence does not confirm 'rich visualization types' beyond basic query graphs/BubbleUp, nor does it show explicit template variable support within Boards (parameterized/reusable dashboards) as a documented feature. missing for 10: explicit documentation of template variables in Boards, evidence of diverse visualization types (e.g., heatmaps, custom charts) beyond standard query results, and independent/hands-on corroboration of dashboard sharing workflow.
